svg.title: A new page (dark theme)
svg.text: Type / for a table, chart, equation, graph, or recording. Draw with the Draw tab.

g.text: Title bar drag area: keep 200+ px empty
Page text: 48 px inset, lines ≤ 72 characters
Page area: at least 480 wide, fills the rest
Pen slots live in the Draw tab; under More until the window is 1600 wide

svg.text: Keep-out zone: nothing interactive or important goes here
Layout region with its size in pixels (at 100% scaling)
